desc: One computer, 3 players, scripted controllers with no device index: 2P asks for Mario's seat on Who's who; nothing moves until 1P's card ('Swap with 2P? A yes / B no') is answered; 1P's A, then the swap at the calm moment moves everything in ports 1 and 2 (2P's scripted controller to Mario's seat, 1P's keyboard and any controller to 2P's); no seat is left without a controller and the game never holds for player 1's; 2P's Start then opens Mario's Start menu
log_must: \[playermenu\] player 1: said yes to a swap
\[together\] 1P says yes to 2P's swap for seat 1
\[together\] seats 1 and 2 swapped \(controllers -?[0-9]+ and -?[0-9]+; keyboard in 2\)
log_must_not: not swapped: one has no controller
